messages.subject: Time recording reminder - January narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Sarah,

Our records show unposted time narratives for January across two matters. Please ensure all time is recorded and narratives finalised by close of play Thursday so we can run the February bills. Thanks,
Accounts
